redaction_note: Per-event venue quote levels (kalshi_reaction / poly_reaction) and absolute wall-clock timestamps (t_ms) are stripped from this pooled artifact. What remains -- which venue led and by how many milliseconds -- is a derived MEASUREMENT, not redistributed venue market data, so this file can be committed under Kalshi's Data Terms and Polymarket's Terms of Use while still regenerating every published number. The unredacted per-event detail stays in the per-game archive under viz/market/leadlag/ (not redistributed). See REPRODUCING.md, Data availability.
